name: Andrés Manuel López Obrador
role: President of Mexico (2018–2024)
quote: We will know the truth about what happened to the 43 students from Ayotzinapa. We will not rest until justice is served.

name: Vidulfo Rosales Sierra
role: Attorney for Ayotzinapa Families / Tlachinollan Center
quote: The families will not stop until all 43 are found and those responsible — including the military — are held accountable.

name: UN Committee on Enforced Disappearances
role: International Oversight Body
quote: Mexico must conduct a thorough, independent investigation and bring all perpetrators to justice, including state actors.

name: Enrique Peña Nieto
role: President of Mexico (2012–2018) — Oversaw Initial Investigation
quote: Ya me cansé. (I'm already tired of the subject.) [Remark widely condemned as dismissive of the families' grief]

name: Jesús Murillo Karam
role: Attorney General (2012–2015) — Author of 'Historical Truth'; arrested 2022
quote: The truth is that the students were killed by Guerreros Unidos and incinerated at the Cocula dump. [Later fully debunked by GIEI]

name: Tomás Zerón de Lucio
role: Former AIC Director — Accused of Evidence Tampering; Fled to Israel
quote: [Denies all charges; claims his investigation was professional and evidence was legitimately discovered]

name: Alejandro Encinas Rodríguez
role: Former Truth Commission Head (2019–2023); Mexico's Ambassador to the OAS — Revealed SEDENA Infiltration Documents (Jul 2026)
quote: This was a crime of state. The state — through its agents — participated in the disappearances. We will not allow institutional protection of the military to continue. [In Jul 2026, released SEDENA documents showing student Julio César López Patolzin was a registered military intelligence asset, contradicting the CNDH's exoneration of the Army days earlier.]

name: Claudia Paz y Paz
role: GIEI Expert (Guatemala) — Led Interdisciplinary Group
quote: The government's version is scientifically and logistically impossible. The real story has yet to be told — and it implicates more than local officials.

name: Ángela María Buitrago
role: GIEI Expert (Colombia) — International Investigator
quote: The pattern of obstruction, evidence tampering, and torture of witnesses points to a systematic cover-up at the highest levels of the Mexican state.

name: Epifanio Guerrero Astudillo
role: Parent of Jhosivani Guerrero de la Cruz — Identified Student
quote: My son was identified. But what about the other 42? We cannot rest. We will not rest. The state owes us the truth.

name: Mario César González
role: Parent of Cesár Manuel González Hernández — Disappeared Student
quote: We have been searching for years while the guilty ones walk free. Where are our children?

name: General José Rodríguez Pérez
role: 27th Infantry Battalion Commander — Arrested Sep 2022 for Forced Disappearance
quote: [Denies charges; military legal team argues the arrests are politically motivated and lack evidentiary basis]

name: Argentine Forensic Anthropology Team (EAAF)
role: Independent Forensic Body — Identified 3 of 43 Students
quote: We can confirm only what the evidence shows. Our work is constrained by access to sites and evidence. Three identifications in 11 years is a humanitarian failure.

name: José Luis Abarca Velázquez
role: Iguala Mayor (2012–2014) — Convicted of Homicide and Forced Disappearance
quote: [Denies ordering the attacks; convicted and imprisoned; families argue his conviction served as a distraction from federal and military accountability]

name: Claudia Sheinbaum
role: President of Mexico (2024–present) — Ruled Out GIEI Return; Distanced Government from CNDH Report
quote: The return of the GIEI will not be possible. [May 29, 2026] ... We did not participate in any way in the CNDH's recommendation. [Jul 13, 2026, ordering Segob to review the report that exonerated the Army]

name: Volker Türk
role: UN High Commissioner for Human Rights — Heard Ayotzinapa Testimony, April 2026
quote: I will continue accompanying the victims and be attentive to this situation. [Met with Ayotzinapa families during April 2026 Mexico visit; families requested he support referral to the UN Committee on Enforced Disappearances.]

name: Rosario Piedra Ibarra
role: President, National Human Rights Commission (CNDH) — Issued Recommendation 208VG/2026
quote: There is no institutional responsibility nor direct military participation in the disappearance of the 43 students. [Jul 9, 2026 recommendation, which recognized 92 victims of grave rights violations but exonerated SEDENA of command-level responsibility — drawing criticism from families, Amnesty International, and Encinas.]

name: Julio César López Patolzin
role: Disappeared Student — Alleged Military Intelligence Asset per Jul 2026 SEDENA Documents
quote: [One of the 43 disappeared on Sep 26, 2014. SEDENA documents released by Encinas in Jul 2026 allege he had been assigned since June 2014 as a military intelligence asset embedded at the Ayotzinapa school — a claim not independently confirmed and disputed by the CNDH's Jul 2026 recommendation.]

name: Ángel Aguirre Rivero
role: Governor of Guerrero (2011–2014, resigned) — Arrested Aug 6, 2026 for Concealing Evidence
quote: I never gave any instruction regarding the handling of said evidentiary material. [Denial issued before his Aug 6, 2026 arrest; the FGR accuses him of ordering the destruction of security-camera footage showing police intercepting bus 1531 on the night of the disappearances. Formally linked to trial for forced disappearance on Aug 12, 2026 — the highest-ranking civilian official charged in the case to date.]

name: Ernestina Godoy Ramos
role: Fiscal General de la República (FGR) — Led Reanalysis Leading to Aguirre's Arrest
quote: It was the result of a deliberate operation structured from the State Executive's highest level. [Statement on the Aug 2026 arrest of former Governor Ángel Aguirre, framing it as the product of a renewed FGR reanalysis of the original 2014 investigation.]

name: Cristina Bautista Salvador
role: Mother of Benjamín Ascencio Bautista — Disappeared Student
quote: Desde aquí le exigimos al juez que no debe dejar en libertad a Ángel Aguirre, debe permanecer en la cárcel el resto de su vida. [Demanding the judge keep former Governor Aguirre imprisoned for life, Aug 12, 2026, after he was formally linked to trial.]
